idea: How to prevent bad smells from drains
title: Why Your Sink Drains Smell (And How to Fix It)
description: Foul odors coming from sink drains are most commonly caused by a dried-out P-trap or accumulated organic buildup inside the drain line. The curved P-trap under your sink is designed to hold a standing water seal that blocks sewer gases from entering your living space. When a sink is rarely used, that water evaporates, breaking the barrier and letting sewer smells escape. To prevent this, run water in every household sink for 30 seconds once a week to restore the water trap seal. For active drains, clear out organic biofilm using warm water and mild flush treatments. If odors persist, consult a licensed plumber to inspect your drain venting system.
